Iron ore downside persists, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' with auction reality check; Chalmers cites Intergenerational Report to defend housing policy
Higher interest rates confirmed as 'new normal', pressuring rate-sensitive sectors
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; government-backed digital pension scheme proposed as parallel to compulsory super
Gold exploration momentum strong: Broken Hill lifts SA resource, Forrestania lands four WA prefeasibility studies, Great Southern hits 10.72g/t
Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman at 96, signalling generational shift in global capital allocation
Diesel/petrol shock rising and Trump trade war 'strangling' global supply chains, elevating energy and input-cost risks

sectors.trend: Iron ore downside persists, pressuring major miners. Gold exploration active with multiple WA/SA discoveries. Rare earths (Dalaroo/Greenland) and antimony-gold (Larvotto) add diversification. Forrestania's four WA prefeasibility studies signal sector confidence.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from soft iron ore. Gold juniors (FOR.AX, BRH.AX, LAR.AX, GSO.AX) attract speculative flows. LNG demand locked in via Sempra supports energy-linked miners.

sectors.trend: Super contributions surge >33% post-budget changes, boosting fund AUM. Digital pension scheme proposal and super 'not fit for purpose' debate signal structural reform risk. Higher rates as 'new normal' pressure mortgage books and property valuations.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher NIM but face credit-risk from housing stress. Super funds (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) see inflow tailwinds. REITs (VGP.AX, SGH.AX) pressured by rate environment.

sectors.trend: Diesel/petrol shock rising; EV adoption accelerating as consumers 'flee the bowser'. Sempra locks 20-year LNG demand. Trump trade war disrupts global energy flows.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure from input costs. BEX.AX, SXG.AX benefit from LNG demand visibility. EV transition (65) is a structural tailwind for battery metals and a headwind for oil majors.

sectors.trend: Consumer weakness broadening: Dollar General CEO flags red flags, Christmas retailer Chapter 11, 80-year discount chain closing 120 stores. Temu IP theft signals competitive pressure on local brands.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX, LSG.AX face margin compression. Defensive consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) may outperform cyclicals. Temu/Shein pressure on local retail (WRB.AX, LNE.AX).

sectors.trend: Atlassian (TEAM) pivots Jira to AI coding; MediaTek challenges Qualcomm with 2nm chip; Cerebras plants 165MW flag. Migraine prevalence doubles, boosting CSL.AX and healthcare demand. Intergenerational Report flags ageing-cost pressure.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global AI capex cycle supports sentiment. CSL.AX, SGH.AX benefit from healthcare demand. Ageing population (8, 32) is a long-term fiscal drag on government spending.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Iron ore weakness, higher-rate normalisation, and Sydney housing correction weigh on materials and financials. Gold and defensive staples offer relative strength. Small-cap momentum (Latrobe, CurveBeam) may persist in a risk-off tape. RBA likely to hold or signal patience given 'higher rates as new normal' narrative.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive for gold, LNG, and healthcare. Super system reform (digital pension, contribution surges) could reshape fund flows. Iron ore structural decline is a multi-year headwind for BHP/RIO/FMG. EV transition and ageing population are secular themes. Buffett's exit signals a new global capital allocation regime. Trade-war resolution or escalation is the key swing factor.
